tool_signatures.name: create_contact
tool_signatures.description:
Create a new contact in Propstack CRM.

Use this tool to:
- Register a new lead after a phone call
- Create a contact from a web form submission
- Add a new property owner

Auto-upserts: if a contact with the same email or old_crm_id already
exists, it will be updated instead of creating a duplicate.

Use get_contact_sources first to find valid source IDs.

email.description: Email address (also used for dedup/upsert matching)

description.description: Free-text description or notes about the contact

client_source_id.description: Lead source ID (use get_contact_sources to look up)

partial_custom_fields.description: Custom field values as key-value pairs (use list_custom_fields to discover available fields)

group_ids.description: Tag/group IDs to assign to this contact

parameters.name: client_source_id
parameters.description: Lead source ID (use get_contact_sources to look up)

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Free-text description or notes about the contact

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Email address (also used for dedup/upsert matching)

parameters.name: group_ids
parameters.description: Tag/group IDs to assign to this contact

parameters.name: partial_custom_fields
parameters.description: Custom field values as key-value pairs (use list_custom_fields to discover available fields)

tool_signatures.name: delete_contact
tool_signatures.description:
Delete a contact from Propstack CRM (soft delete).

The contact is moved to a 30-day recycle bin and can be restored.

Use this tool for:
- GDPR deletion requests (Art. 17 DSGVO)
- Removing duplicate contacts
- Cleaning up test data

tool_signatures.name: delete_webhook
tool_signatures.description:
Delete a webhook subscription from Propstack.

Removes the webhook so Propstack will stop sending events to its URL.

tool_signatures.name: get_contact_favorites
tool_signatures.description:
Get properties that a contact has favorited/bookmarked.

Returns the list of properties the contact has marked as favorites
in Propstack. Use to understand which listings a buyer is most
interested in.

tool_signatures.name: list_webhooks
tool_signatures.description:
List all configured webhooks in Propstack.

Returns each webhook with its URL, subscribed events, active status,
and HMAC secret. Use to review existing automation triggers.

tool_signatures.name: smart_lead_intake
tool_signatures.description:
Complete lead intake workflow — dedup check, create/update contact,
log notes, create deal if specific property, and set follow-up reminder.

Perfect for post-call processing from a voice agent. Handles the entire
intake in one tool call:

1. If phone or email provided → search for existing contact (dedup)
2. If found → update contact; if not → create new contact
3. If notes provided → log as a note task
4. If property_id provided → create deal at first pipeline stage
5. Create follow-up reminder for broker (due tomorrow 9am)

Returns what was done: created vs updated, IDs of all created records.

phone.description: Phone number (also used for dedup search)

email.description: Email address (also used for dedup search)

source_id.description: Lead source ID (use get_contact_sources to look up)

notes.description: Call notes or free-text about the interaction

property_interest.description: Free text about what the lead is looking for (logged as note, not parsed into search profile)

property_id.description: Specific property ID the lead is interested in (creates a deal)

parameters.description: Email address (also used for dedup search)

parameters.name: phone

tool_signatures.name: update_contact
tool_signatures.description:
Update an existing contact in Propstack CRM.

Use this tool to:
- Update contact details after a call
- Change broker assignment
- Add or remove tags (Merkmale)
- Update GDPR status
- Change contact rating or status

Tag management options:
- group_ids: replaces ALL tags with this list
- add_group_ids: adds tags without removing existing ones
- sub_group_ids: removes specific tags

Only provide the fields you want to change.

partial_custom_fields.description: Custom field values as key-value pairs

group_ids.description: Replace ALL tags with this list of tag IDs

add_group_ids.description: Add these tag IDs without removing existing tags

sub_group_ids.description: Remove these tag IDs from the contact

parameters.name: add_group_ids
parameters.description: Add these tag IDs without removing existing tags

parameters.name: group_ids
parameters.description: Replace ALL tags with this list of tag IDs

parameters.name: partial_custom_fields
parameters.description: Custom field values as key-value pairs

parameters.name: sub_group_ids
parameters.description: Remove these tag IDs from the contact

tool_signatures.name: update_deal
tool_signatures.description:
Update an existing deal in Propstack.

Use this tool to:
- Move a deal to the next pipeline stage (change deal_stage_id)
- Update expected/agreed price
- Add or update notes
- Change broker assignment
- Update feeling score after contact
- Record cancellation reason

Only provide the fields you want to change.

deal_stage_id.description: Pipeline stage ID — change this to move through pipeline

parameters.name: deal_stage_id
parameters.description: Pipeline stage ID — change this to move through pipeline
